title.zh: Datadog拿智谱GLM训练运维AI：90项故障测评解80项，与GPT-6 Astra同分
title.en: Datadog拿智谱GLM训练运维AI：90项故障测评解80项，与GPT-6 Astra同分

current_state.zh: Datadog released Scout 1.0, a dedicated AI operations model fine-tuned from Zhipu's open-source GLM-5.3 Flash via reinforcement learning on real incident data, scoring 80/90 on the SREGym fault-diagnosis benchmark and offering 3-8x lower inference cost than comparable frontier models, currently in closed preview.
